title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：phase　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 phase 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the observer ① entered the phase that no assistant in the observatory would have noted, and he said the entering was the whole of the night. The ② phase, meaning the stage itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed unnoted in the book; a phase, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ phase in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ phase at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A phase, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the observer said the noting is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the phase was the whole of the matter, meaning the change and not the stage. The ⑥ phase, meaning the change and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; phase, he said, is either something you enter or the only word that means both a stage and a change. He said the change is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ phase had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ phase of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of noting; phase, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ phase I remember is the stage noted in the log, which closed in 1990 and is still noted as the quietest in the observatory. A ⑩ phase, my mother said in 1992, is the only stage that improves by being noted; every phase, she said, is a change that has agreed to look like a stage. She said the change was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 阶段；时期（指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个）
B. n. 阶段；时期（指那个阶段本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：enter the phase 进入这一个阶段
D. n. 阶段；时期（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 阶段之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的阶段之事）
F. n. 阶段；时期（指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一个）
G. n. 阶段、转机（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 转机（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: entered the phase that no assistant in the observatory would have noted
The phase, meaning the stage itself and not the lens
the phase at the far dome
the phase was the whole of the matter
the phase had become a line in a log
The phase of the whole thing
A phase, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: enter the phase 意为“进入这一个阶段”，1983 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯记下的一个阶段做了一遍。
phase 意为“阶段；时期”，指那个阶段本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被记下。
phase 意为“阶段；时期”，指观测站里每一个旁边的那一个，每一个旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
phase 意为“阶段；时期”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
phase 意为“阶段、转机”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这个转机就是那件事的全部。
phase 意为“转机”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那个阶段，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
phase 意为“阶段；时期”，指观测记录里写到、被记下的那一个，到 1988 年这一个成了观测记录里的一行。
phase 意为“阶段之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的阶段之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的记下。
phase 意为“阶段；时期”，我记得的是观测记录里记下过的那一个，1990 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一个。
phase 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，阶段是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的阶段。
